title: Canonical proper coefficient mate and acyclic model maps
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital homomorphism, and $r:W\to V$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Work in ordinary constant-coefficient small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with localization $Q$, direct image $r_*$ and its right derived functor [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and inverse image with its adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Write $S_T=-\otimes_A^L B$ and let $\lambda_r:r_B^*S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Wr_A^*$ be the canonical K-flat-normalized comparison [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso]. Define $\operatorname{properCoefficientMap}(\varphi,r):S_VRr_{*,A}\to Rr_{*,B}S_W$ to be the $r_B^*\dashv Rr_{*,B}$ transpose of $\lambda_r$ followed by $S_W$ of the $A$-counit. For any cochain complex $C$ of $A$-module sheaves on $W$, define $\operatorname{coefficientExtendedComplex}(\varphi,W,C)$ by applying the ordinary sheafified scalar-extension functor termwise, with the same differential maps after scalar extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Define $\operatorname{properAcyclicComparison}(A,r,C):Q(r_{*,A}C)\to Rr_{*,A}(QC)$ as the canonical right-derived-functor unit on the homotopy quotient of $C$, preceded by $Q_h$ of the inverse of the canonical factorization of degreewise direct image through that quotient. These constructions are defined for every $C$ and $r$; no boundedness, flatness, acyclicity, properness or Noetherian hypothesis is required merely to define the maps.
